description: This file provides a wrapper around GLib functions, including factory methods for creating GLib wrapper instances, and utility functions for GLib object manipulation and string operations. It also manages singleton instances of the wrapper objects and includes logging for error handling.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods to interact with GLib objects and strings, encapsulating GLib function calls.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IGlibWrapper and IGlibWrapperFactory.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton instance of GlibWrapperFactory, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton instance of IGlibWrapper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Retrieves properties from a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds a property in a GObjectClass by name.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Creates a formatted string using GLib's g_strdup_vprintf.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specified prefix.
